title: RGB565 Color Mixer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: Mix a color with RGB sliders and see it packed into 16-bit RGB565, with 5-6-5 bit groups, hex, the color565() call, lost detail, a gradient banding view, and a Predict mode.

learningObjectives: Analyze how many bits of color detail are lost in each channel

keyQuestions: Which red values pack to the same RGB565 value?
commonMisconceptions: RGB565 shows every color your computer can show
Changing a channel by 1 always changes the displayed color
assessmentOpportunities: Explain why red 250 and 253 look the same on the display
